name: ModelSamplingAV / MiniMaxH3SigmaShift
plain: A flow table for packed audio-video latents. The video shift drives the schedule; the audio shift is stored and sets an audio scale, and both go to the model through transformer options so it can derive the audio schedule. The vsaan212 fallback differs: it uses the plain flow table, so it stores no audio shift or audio scale and passes the audio shift only through transformer options.
math: σ table: time_snr_shift(shift_video, k/1000). audio_scale = shift_video/shift_audio (1.0 if shift_audio is None). transformer_options carries both. vsaan212 fallback: same table on ModelSamplingDiscreteFlow, no audio_scale.

audit.note: The math does not hold for every listed provider. The vsaan212 fallback builds ModelSamplingDiscreteFlow and calls set_parameters(shift=shift_video) (Lazy_minimax/_nodes_minimax_h3_fallback.py:309-314), so it has no audio_shift or audio_scale; only the transformer options carry the audio shift. Core and PGCRT use ModelSamplingAV. Also audio_scale is 1.0 when audio_shift is None (ComfyUI/comfy/model_sampling.py:355-356).
